name: Snap Finance UK Checkout
author: snapfinanceuk

sections.description:
Snap Finance UK Checkout provides a fully integrated finance application process at the WooCommerce checkout. Customers can apply for finance directly within a secure modal popup, without being redirected off-site. This improves conversion rates, enhances the customer experience, and enables merchants to offer flexible, risk-based financing options.

Snap Finance UK offers instant decisions in minutes with multiple layers of verification, making finance accessible even to customers who may face financial constraints. With direct API communication, secure authentication, and auto-sync between WooCommerce orders and Snap Finance applications, this plugin ensures reliability and compliance.

External Services

This plugin integrates with Snap Finance UK, a third-party service, to provide customer finance eligibility checks and to process finance applications during WooCommerce checkout.

Services used:
– sandbox-platform.snapfinance.co.uk
– platform.snapfinance.co.uk
– dev-qa1-platform.snapfinance.co.uk
– checkout-prod-uk.uk.auth0.com
– checkout-dev-uk.eu.auth0.com
– prod-api.snapfinance.co.uk

Purpose:
– Submit finance applications
– Retrieve application status
– Confirm delivery completion

Data sent:
When a customer selects Snap Finance UK as the payment method during checkout, the plugin sends the following data to Snap Finance UK:
– Order total
– Customer name
– Contact details
– Application ID

Privacy Policy:
https://snapfinance.co.uk/privacy-policy

Terms of Service:
https://snapfinance.co.uk/terms-and-conditions

Key Features

  • Fully integrated Snap Finance UK payment method for WooCommerce
  • Finance application via a built-in modal (no redirection)
  • Fast approval — decisions within minutes
  • Risk-based pricing for tailored finance options
  • APIs for application status, delivery confirmation, and order linking
  • Auto-sync of order details, transaction references, and application IDs
  • Sandbox, QA, and Production mode selections
  • Custom logging (WooCommerce Logger)
  • Hooks & filters for developers
  • Compatible with Classic Checkout and Checkout Blocks
  • Secure authentication using OAuth2 Client Credentials

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder snapfinanceuk-payment to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → SnapFinanceUK Payment.
  4. Enable the payment method.
  5. Enter your:
    • Client ID
    • Client Secret
    • API Environment (Sandbox / QA / Production)
    • Other required credentials
  6. Save changes.
  7. The Snap Finance UK option will now appear on the WooCommerce checkout page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes. The plugin integrates seamlessly with both Classic Checkout and the new WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

Do I need a Snap Finance UK merchant account?

Yes. You must have valid API credentials from Snap Finance UK to use this plugin.

Are API calls secure?

All API calls use OAuth2 Client Credentials and are transmitted over HTTPS.

Does the plugin store sensitive financial information?

No. All sensitive data is processed securely by Snap Finance UK. The plugin only stores necessary identifiers such as application ID and reference numbers.

Can customers complete applications on mobile devices?

Yes. The modal and API flows are fully mobile responsive.
